day_shape: 78 items: UKMTO-reported tanker strike exiting Strait of Hormuz, Treasury sanctions on France-based Hamas financing network, Rubio-Abdullah call on Hezbollah disarmament, Saudi-Houthi strike exchange across Yemen, and heavy IRGC messaging on True Promise 2 anniversary.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incident
threads.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile while exiting the Strait of Hormuz, as reported by Jerusalem Post and Defa Press. Iran International separately examined Caspian trade routes as an alternative to southern corridors disrupted by war.

threads.label: US sanctions and Middle East posture
threads.summary: The State Department announced Treasury designations targeting a Hamas operative in Gaza and a France-based fundraising network that collected nearly $2 million via sham charities and crypto. Jerusalem Post reported US planning for a possible naval surge of up to three carriers, while NSC counterterrorism director Gorka told the paper "Iran will imminently be resolved."

threads.label: Rubio-Jordan call on Lebanon track
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio spoke with King Abdullah II on implementing the Trilateral Framework in Lebanon, disarming Hezbollah, and Syrian stability. Defa Press separately reported Syrian and Turkish government denials of Reuters reporting on alleged Syria-Hezbollah talks on Turkish soil.

threads.label: Yemen escalation and diplomacy
threads.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed Saudi Arabia conducted 94 airstrikes across six Yemeni provinces in 24 hours, while a Yemeni air force spokesperson reported 20 strikes on Houthi targets in Taiz. Pakistan's FM said Iran had proposed political engagement with the Houthis ahead of a Riyadh emergency meeting, as Jerusalem Post reported Saudi plans for a Yemeni-led operation to secure Red Sea routes.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and hostage reveal
threads.summary: The IDF announced the elimination of Hamas sniper Tamer Hamaida in a joint strike with ISA in Khan Yunis. The military also disclosed that Izz al-Din al-Bik, commander of Hamas's Northern Gaza Brigade killed earlier in the week, had commanded the captivity of Israeli hostages and participated in the October 7 infiltration.

threads.label: IRGC messaging on True Promise 2 anniversary
threads.summary: The IRGC issued a statement marking the second anniversary of Operation True Promise 2 declaring "the era of cost-free threats has ended," with Deputy Commander Ezzeddin claiming "technological surprises" for enemies. SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei posted against Trump, Khamenei's office circulated prayer-conference and spiritual messages, and Defa Press posted on Qaani at a resistance-leaders commemoration.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain and Sistan violence
threads.summary: Iran International reported five killed in a roadside attack near Zahedan, confirmed by the IRGC's Quds Command, which also announced the dismantling of a terrorist cell in Sistan and Baluchestan. Separate Iran International pieces documented a sinking rial driving investors into stocks and gold, a 30% drop at a central truck-repair hub, upheld jail term for actress Elnaz Shakerdoost, and denied reports of teacher resignations.
